display_title: His Majesty is Vexed by His Handmaiden
description:
A beautiful and powerful young emperor—Klaiden A. Rokarso. Before his looks and overwhelming dignity, everyone loses themselves… Everyone, except one. A maid who remains calm and completely unmoved. Perfect without a flaw, always composed— Emilia Valetta. But that indifferent expression starts to get under the Emperor’s skin. And the more his irritation builds the more his desire to conquer flares to life. 'She's the first person who hasn’t fallen for me.' He won’t stop until her composure cracks. Until her eyes finally turn to him. Until Emilia Valetta falls, completely, helplessly, and undeniably, into his hands.

(Source: Naver, translated)
